cpu: Intel Core i9-12900KF, 16 physical cores, 24 logical processors
scratch_storage: C: NTFS, fixed NVMe SSD, approximately 2 TB
native_concurrency: one worker except explicitly labeled two-reader probe
warmup: one untimed call per repeated-read or component group; mutation/prepare observations have no separate identical mutation warmup
repetitions: five timed reads/component repeats on the same store; one effect observation per exact history and composition; three pairs for two-reader contention
dependency_lock: harness Cargo.lock seeded from workspace lock; existing dependency versions retained
clock: std::time::Instant wall time inside process; setup, population and recursive byte counting outside timers
cache: warm process/filesystem caches; not a cold-cache, restart or dedicated idle-machine benchmark
byte_metric: regular-file contents beneath .handbook/work-state, excludes root anchor/bootstrap, filesystem allocation and owner accounting overhead
synthetic: repeated actual kind-item intent streamed through serde Value decode/canonicalization/SHA256; no native proof or support beyond32
